lines: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hive_example_sales (region STRING, city STRING, month STRING, product STRING, quantity INT, unit_price DOUBLE);
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM hive_example_sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT product, month, SUM(quantity) AS quantity FROM hive_example_sales GROUP BY product, month ORDER BY product, month;
